description: This file defines the Gamma class with methods for gamma function calculations, gamma distribution, inverse gamma distribution, and gamma logarithm, used in statistical calculations within PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: Provides methods for gamma function calculations, gamma distribution, inverse gamma distribution, and gamma logarithm.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Calculates the gamma function value for a given input.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Returns the gamma distribution or its cumulative distribution function.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the gamma distribution for a given probability.

methods.name: ln
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function.
